name: ai.hashgrid/sdk
title: Hashgrid DNA (text, local)
description: Search that learns from feedback, over text: embeds locally, sends DNA only vectors.

environmentVariables.name: HASHGRID_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your DNA API key, hg-…. No key yet? Write to office@hashgrid.ai.

environmentVariables.name: HASHGRID_EMBEDDER
environmentVariables.description: The embedder, one per grid: fastembed:<model> (local), openai:<model> or voyage:<model>.

environmentVariables.name: HASHGRID_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: The local index: a sqlite file that maps DNA ids to your text.
